svg.title: Tokamak, cutaway
svg.desc: Cutaway of a generic tokamak: a D-shaped toroidal vacuum vessel around the separated plasma, a central solenoid on the axis, D-shaped toroidal-field coils and horizontal poloidal-field coils.
